subtasks.instructions: Compute the average departure delay in minutes across all completed (cancelled=false) flights operated by all six carriers during January and February 2025. Use each unique flight_id only once because the export may contain repeated records. For AA, B6, DL, UA, and WN, date/sched_dep/actual_dep are local origin-airport date/times. For AS, date_utc/sched_dep_utc/actual_dep_utc are UTC; convert each scheduled and actual timestamp to local time at the origin airport using airports.csv utc_offset_hours before determining the local date/month and delay. Handle actual departures after midnight by using full datetimes, not clock-time subtraction. Include only completed flights whose local scheduled departure date is in January or February 2025 (months refer to local origin time). Departure delay is actual datetime minus scheduled datetime in minutes; early departures must remain negative. Report total unique completed flights included, sum of delays, and the arithmetic mean rounded to one decimal place. Also flag any unusual/missing/ambiguous records and explain the deduplication and timezone handling.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
aps=pd.read_csv('airports.csv').set_index('airport')
# dedupe preserving first
u=allr.drop_duplicates('flight_id',keep='first').copy()
issues=[]
# normalize
sched=[]; actual=[]
for i,r in u.iterrows():
 try:
  if r['carrier']=='AS':
   s=pd.to_datetime(str(r['date_utc'])+' '+str(r['sched_dep_utc']),errors='raise')+pd.to_timedelta(float(aps.loc[r.origin,'utc_offset_hours']),unit='h')
   a=pd.to_datetime(str(r['date_utc'])+' '+str(r['actual_dep_utc']),errors='raise')+pd.to_timedelta(float(aps.loc[r.origin,'utc_offset_hours']),unit='h')
  else:
   s=pd.to_datetime(str(r['date'])+' '+str(r['sched_dep']),errors='raise')
   a=pd.to_datetime(str(r['date'])+' '+str(r['actual_dep']),errors='raise')
  sched.append(s);actual.append(a)
 except Exception as e: sched.append(pd.NaT);actual.append(pd.NaT); issues.append((r.flight_id,str(e)))
u['s']=sched;u['a']=actual
# report invalid, unknown origin etc
print('parse invalid',u.s.isna().sum(),issues)
print('cancelled vals',u.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict(),'origins unknown',set(u.origin)-set(aps.index))
sel=u[(u.cancelled==False)&u.s.notna()&u.a.notna()&(u.s.dt.date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01').date())&(u.s.dt.date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-02-28').date())].copy()
sel['delay']=(sel.a-sel.s).dt.total_seconds()/60
print(len(sel),sel.delay.sum(),sel.delay.mean())
print('all unique completed',((u.cancelled==False)&u.s.notna()&u.a.notna()).sum())
print('by carrier',sel.groupby('carrier').delay.agg(['count','sum','mean']))
print('weird delays',sel[ (sel.delay>360)|(sel.delay< -180)][['flight_id','carrier','s','a','delay']].to_string(index=False))
print('outside scheduled dates',u[(u.cancelled==False)&u.s.notna() & ~((u.s.dt.month.isin([1,2]))&(u.s.dt.year==2025))].shape)
